We're not a flash\-in\-the\-pan tech startup—instead, we blend time\-honored legal experience with innovative technology to redefine how depositions are conducted. Our team spans legal professionals, product owners, engineers, client\-success leads, and security specialists, all collaborating seamlessly to ensure every deposition is a success. Join us, and become part of a community where rich experience meets forward\-thinking innovation, and where your talents help make the legal journey better for everyone. **About the role**  

The Reporter Training Specialist\- Testimony Capture is responsible for sourcing, onboarding, and training court reporters within the Testimony Capture department. This role helps design and maintain training programs, documentation, and quality standards to ensure reporters are fully prepared to deliver high\-quality services. Works cross\-functionally with Operations, Assignments, Production, and Customer Support to support reporter readiness, platform proficiency, and ongoing performance.

* Manages onboarding process, including documentation, system access, and initial readiness checks
* Trains reporters on company processes, operational expectations, and quality standards
* Delivers training on Remote Legal platforms and related technology tools
* Creates, maintains, and updates training scenarios, guides, and reference materials
* Develops procedures and training documentation to support consistency and quality across reporting team
* Coordinates with Operations and Assignments to identify training needs and performance gaps
* Provides refresher training, updates, and process rollouts as procedures evolve
* Supports remediation and targeted retraining when quality or compliance issues are identified
* Maintains accurate training records and onboarding documentation for reporters
* Monitors training effectiveness and recommends improvements based on feedback and outcomes
* Ensures training aligns with legal, procedural, and company standards
* Develop, review, and update the quality rubric to ensure alignment with company standards
* Establish and enforce a consistent cadence for feedback
* Facilitate and lead regular quality calibration sessions
* Create and distribute detailed feedback based on quality reviews and audits
* Review markups and scorecards prepared by others for accuracy and consistency
* Maintains strict confidentiality of all company, client, and reporter information

* Leads performance management activities for direct reports, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, documentation, and support for corrective action when needed

* Ability to clearly communicate processes and technical concepts
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding and training workflows simultaneously
* High attention to detail and quality standards
* Problem\-solving mindset with ability to adapt training to reporter needs
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop team members in a remote environment
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, remote environment
* Experience with court reporting workflows or legal proceedings preferred
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with multiple departments

o Experience in training, onboarding, operations, or related roles
o Experience in legal, court reporting, or related environments **W****ork Environment*** This is a primarily remote position performed from a home office or approved remote work location; limited travel may be required periodically for training, meetings, or other business needs.

What We Do
  
  

We help Financial Professionals build and grow their business in a variety of different ways. With over 40,000 clients benefiting from our innovative solutions, we are dedicated to transforming their marketing efforts into growth engines. FMG is the leading all\-in\-one digital marketing platform empowering financial advisors, insurance agents, and enterprises with scalable and compliant marketing solutions designed to drive organic growth.
  
  

Consistently ranked \#1 in market and customer satisfaction in the T3 Software Survey Report, FMG helps clients stay ahead of evolving trends and effectively implement marketing best practices. Through an intuitive, centralized platform, FMG enables users to efficiently manage websites, email, texting, social media, events, blogs, videos, and more—all in one place.
  
  

About Our Culture
  
  

At FMG, we have crafted an extraordinary work environment that perfectly balances hard work with an incredible team spirit. Since our inception over a decade ago, we've grown into a thriving community of 450\+ dedicated employees spread across the globe. Our fast\-paced, results\-driven culture is matched by our commitment to maintaining a healthy work/life balance, ensuring that our team members feel fulfilled both personally and professionally.
  
  

Collaboration and open, thoughtful communication are at the heart of what we do. Our mission is to invest in motivated, successful individuals, supporting them as they excel both inside and outside of the workplace.
  
  

We're building a winning team of A\+ players, and we invite you to be a part of this amazing journey. At FMG, you'll find an environment that champions growth, celebrates achievements, and fosters a sense of belonging. Join us, and let's create something extraordinary together!
  
  

Our Employee Benefits
  
  

At FMG, we’re serious about being an awesome place to work! We’ve earned the USA Top Workplace award four years running now, and we’re always looking for ways to keep things great—like regularly checking in on our benefits and pay to make sure you’re getting a truly competitive package.
  
  

Enjoy a generous paid holiday schedule, including a full week off for our Winter Holiday Shutdown.
  
Our comprehensive paid time off policies cover vacation, sick days, parental leave, and bereavement leave.
  
  

**Our robust insurance plan includes:**

Dental
  
Vision

Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  
Company\-paid Life Insurance and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) coverage
  
Company\-paid Short \& Long Term Disability coverage
  
Company\-paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  
Matching 401(k) with immediate full vesting
  
On Demand Pay \- allows access to a portion of your earned wages prior to the payday with same day deposit
  
Internet \& Gym Reimbursement!
  
We’ll provide you with the work computer equipment you need to set you up for success!
  
Access to a private \& secure workspace, free from distractions
  
Accessible during the assigned work schedule for regular duties and responsibilities as outlined by the supervisor
  
An internet connection with speeds of 5 Megabits down / 3 Megabits up (5mbps/3mbps)
  
Our Employee Events Committee and managers are always planning a mix of fun in\-person and virtual events to keep us all connected—plus we also love to throw in some FMG swag, so you can show off your company spirit in style!
  
About the Role
  
  

The Director of Onboarding Delivery owns the client\-facing onboarding experience for every client moving through implementation, across all FMG products in the Wealth and Protection \& Benefits verticals. Implementation runs through three functions, onboarding, creative, and technical build. This role owns onboarding, the relationship with the client and the experience of being guided from kickoff through launch. It works closely with the creative and build teams but does not own their output. If a client feels lost, uninformed, or surprised at any point in implementation, that is this role's problem to solve.
  
  

Two managers report into this role, one leading onboarding for the Wealth business, which covers Essential and Premium, and one leading onboarding for Protection \& Benefits. Today the two organizations run on different processes, different tooling, different escalation paths, and different definitions of done, and that same gap exists inside Wealth between Essential and Premium. This role is responsible for building one operating model across all of it, meaning a single delivery rhythm, a single set of standards, a common KPI framework, and documented process.
  
  

The combination required here is uncommon. You need to be a genuine manager of managers, able to hold two experienced leaders to a standard. You need the operational depth to look at the onboarding experience and see where clients are waiting, where they're confused, and where the process is breaking down before they notice it themselves. And you need to think about the process, with a documented current state, a defined target state, and a sequenced plan to get from one to the other. The goal is not to run onboarding delivery as it exists today. It is to build what it needs to become.
  
  

Compensation This position offers $80,000\-$100,000 depending on qualifications and experience.
  
Primary Responsibilities \& Expectations
  
  

Onboarding Delivery Across Verticals and Every Product Line
  
Own the client's onboarding experience for every client across Wealth and Protection \& Benefits, from intake through launch day.
  
Hold the client relationship through the creative and build phases, keeping the client informed, setting expectations, and managing escalations, even when the work itself is happening on other teams.
  
Hold accountability for time to launch, client satisfaction at launch, and escalation volume across every product line simultaneously.
  
Know where each pipeline is stalling and why, at any point in the month, so client\-facing timelines and expectations stay accurate.
  
Protect the client experience through periods of volume, staffing change, and product change
  
One Operating Model
  
Build and enforce a single delivery operating model across Wealth and P\&B, including intake, assignment, QC, escalation, and go\-live.
  
Standardize where standardizing helps and leave real product differences alone. Wealth’s Essential and Premium are different economics and should not be forced into one process for the sake of symmetry. P\&B’s Fuse and Forge products have very different needs to launch.
  
Own the SOP library for all onboarding delivery, and hold managers accountable for keeping it current.
  
Reduce the amount of process that lives only in an individual's head. Anything critical is documented and covered by more than one person.
  
Leading Through Managers
  
Lead, coach, and develop two Onboarding Managers, and hold them to the same standard you expect them to hold their teams to.
  
Run a consistent weekly one\-on\-one rhythm, with commitments logged before the meeting and progress checked at the next one.
  
Own succession and bench depth across the team lead layer. No team should be a single point of failure.
  
Set the culture across the onboarding specialists and coordinators who sit under your two managers, even though you do not manage them directly.
  
KPIs and Performance Management
  
Own the outcomes for onboarding, including launches, time to launch, and client satisfaction.
  
Ensure every team under you has a defined, documented KPI set.
  
Diagnose the difference between a people problem and a process problem.
  
Deliver accurate, defensible reporting to the VP of Delivery Enablement and Implementation, and to senior leadership, on the agreed cadence.
  
Capacity, Staffing, and Cost
  
Own capacity planning for onboarding across Wealth and Protection \& Benefits, including seasonality, month\-end peaks, PTO, and enterprise spillover.
  
Build the staffing case with evidence when the volume genuinely requires it, and find the efficiency first when it does not.
  
Manage the cost of onboarding delivery, including headcount, contract and vendor capacity, and the cost of the automation you deploy.
  
Cross\-Functional Partnership
  
Partner with Creative Delivery and Technical Delivery, all of whom sit outside this org but inside every build timeline.
  
Partner with the Director of Enterprise Onboarding \& Migrations on the enterprise work that lands inside your teams, and flag conflicts with the retail queue early rather than absorbing them silently.
  
Work with Sales on what is being sold, what is being promised, and where the two are drifting apart.
  
Feed recurring build friction back to Product with specifics and volume attached.
  
What This Role Does Not Own
  
Support and service once a client's product is live. This organization delivers onboarding through launch. Once implementation is complete, the client belongs to Client Experience.
  
Post\-launch site edits, maintenance, and ongoing client relationship management.
  
Enterprise onboarding programs and advisor migrations, which sit with the Director of Enterprise Onboarding \& Migrations.
  
Design and copywriting production, which sits with the Creative Delivery organization.
  
Fulfillment and front\-end development capacity, which sits with the Technical Delivery organization.
  
AI\-First Expectation
  
  

FMG is building an AI\-first delivery organization, and the Director of Onboarding Delivery is expected to be the internal driver of that shift across onboarding. Onboarding is full of repetitive, rules\-based steps, intake, status updates, scheduling, escalations, and handoffs, which makes it one of the highest\-leverage places in the company to apply automation. Identifying those steps, testing honestly whether the automation actually holds up, and making the ones that work into the standard way the teams operate is a core part of this job.
  
  

This goes beyond using AI personally. It means deploying it at the team level, building the playbooks and standards that govern how it is used, and holding your managers accountable for adoption. It also means being honest about cost. Automation that shifts spend from labor to tooling without moving throughput or cycle time is not a win, and this role is expected to know the difference and say so.
  
  

AI gives people more context, faster answers, and more time for the parts of onboarding that genuinely require judgment, the moments with the client that actually matter. We are not looking for someone who is curious about AI. We are looking for someone who already thinks in systems and sees AI as the most powerful leverage point in a modern delivery organization.
  
  

What You Bring
  
  

This role sits at the intersection of people leadership, operational rigor, and process design. All three are required.
  
  

Experience and Background
  
  

5\+ years in delivery, implementation, or client operations leadership, including 2\+ years managing managers.
  
Proven ownership of a high\-volume production or build operation with real deadlines and real client consequences.
  
Track record of consolidating or standardizing operations that previously ran as separate teams.
  
Experience owning and defending team performance metrics at the leadership level, and running a documented performance management process.
  
Experience building capacity models and making the staffing case with evidence.
  
SaaS, digital agency, or web production background strongly preferred. Financial services or insurance experience is a plus.
  
Fluency with the systems that run this work, including HubSpot, ClickUp, and reporting tooling.
  
  

Skills and Qualifications
  
  

Manages managers well. Sets the standard, holds the line, and does not take the work back.
  
Comfortable with a hard conversation, and does not defer it.
  
Thinks in process and systems. Can document a current state, define a target state, and sequence the path between them.
  
Can read a pipeline or backlog, finds the actual constraint, and acts on it rather than on the loudest symptom.
  
Strong judgment about what to standardize and what to leave alone.
  
Clear, direct communication with executives, peers, and clients.
  
Steady in a changing environment, and a stabilizing presence for the teams underneath it.
  
Client\-obsessed, with the discipline to protect the client experience while still improving margin.

We strive to foster an environment that allows everyone to contribute to our mission in their unique ways. With the belief that diversity propels innovation, we are continually finding ways to cultivate a commitment to inclusion in our employees, services, and products, as well as in the communities in which we live and work.

Doing both well, and at scale, takes a specific kind of person. You need the executive presence to hold a hard conversation with a client's senior leadership, the operational rigor to run a thousand\-account migration without losing accounts, and enough technical depth to speak with product and engineering. Just as important, you need to think like a product person. The process here is a product. It needs a documented current state, a defined target state, and a sequenced roadmap of changes to get from one to the other, with the reasoning written down so the team can execute the plan.
  
  

You are helping create Enterprise Onboarding and Migrations as a real function, with documented process, defensible reporting, and a team structured to scale, while running live client programs. The goal is not to manage enterprise onboarding as it exists today. It is to build what it needs to become.
  
  

Compensation This position offers $80,000\-$120,000 depending on qualifications and experience.
  
Primary Responsibilities \& Expectations
  
  

Enterprise Onboarding Delivery
  
  

Own the outcome of every enterprise onboarding program, from kick\-off through go\-live and transition to ongoing support.
  
Hold accountability for scope, timeline, milestones, and the issue log across all active programs simultaneously.
  
Own the website onboarding pipeline at scale, including advisor request intake, template governance, build coverage, and active project reporting.
  
Own P\&B Enterprise project management, working closely with the Agency Revolution team to fulfill the projects.
  
Build and enforce the SOPs, templates, and infrastructure that make onboarding repeatable instead of custom each time.
  
Treat the process as a product. Maintain a roadmap of process and system improvements, sequence it against client demand, and drive it to completion with home office, product, and engineering partners.
  
Identify where a client's request exceeds the standard package and drive the decision on scope, effort, and cost rather than absorbing it silently.
  
Migrations
  
Carry ultimate accountability for the outcome of every migration, including accuracy, completeness, timeline, and advisor/home office experience.
  
The team executes migrations day to day. You own the team, the method, and the result. Your job is to make sure they have a defined process, realistic capacity, and a clear quality bar, and to answer for the outcome when they do not.
  
Hold the Migrations Manager accountable for execution quality and develop that person into a genuine owner of the function.
  
**Set the methodology:** determine when an automation is the right route, when a manual migration is required, and what bar has to be met before a migration wave is considered done.
  
Own migration capacity planning, including sizing waves, sequencing them against client deadlines, and scaling external vendor capacity up and down as volume demands.
  
Establish the verification and QA standard so a completed migration is proven complete, not assumed complete.
  
**Manage the risk surface:** advisor communications, compliance resubmission, live\-site continuity, in\-flight builds, and the handoffs to billing, subscriptions, and support.
  
Report on progress to our enterprise partners, internally and externally, along the way.
  
Scoping and Pre\-Sale Support
  
Join discovery and scoping calls with sales and business development partners on enterprise opportunities.
  
Own feasibility assessment and effort sizing, and give a defensible answer on what FMG can deliver, in what timeframe, and at what cost in team hours.
  
Say no, or say "not that way," when an ask is not deliverable as scoped, and bring the alternative that is.
  
Client Leadership and Escalation
  
Serve as the senior escalation point for enterprise clients when a program is at risk or a client is unhappy.
  
Set and reset expectations with client\-side executives directly, with the authority to hold a position under pressure.
  
Own the odd\-shaped programs that do not fit any standard flow, and build the approach where none exists.
  
Team Leadership
  
Lead a small, senior team today, including a Migrations Manager, an Enterprise Onboarding Project Manager, and two Enterprise Onboarding Specialists, and scale it as the book grows.
  
Set clear KPIs and performance standards for the team, and hold people to them with documented, consistent follow\-through.
  
Build the team and process a repeatable system.
  
Reporting and Operating Rhythm
  
Deliver a weekly state of the union across the full enterprise portfolio: in scoping, in build, at risk, and launching.
  
Maintain a single trustworthy source of program status that leadership can act on without asking clarifying questions.
  
Bring problems forward early with a recommendation attached, not after they have become client\-visible.
  
What This Role Does Not Own \- Named deliberately, because clarity here protects the role.
  
Design and copywriting production, which sits with the Design and Content organization within Customer Delivery.
  
The ongoing business\-as\-usual home office relationship after a program transitions to support.
  
Net\-new enterprise deal ownership, pricing authority, and contracting, which sit with Business Development.
  
SMB and premium onboarding delivery for Wealth and P\&B, which sits with the Director of Onboarding Delivery.
  
AI\-First Expectation
  
  

FMG is building an AI\-first delivery organization, and the Director of Enterprise Onboarding \& Migrations is expected to be the internal driver of that shift for this function. That means identifying where AI tools and automation can replace the manual, repetitive work that dominates migrations and onboarding today, building the playbooks and standards that govern their use, and holding the team accountable for meaningful adoption. Migrations in particular are full of high\-volume, rules\-based, verifiable work, which makes this function one of the highest\-leverage places in the company to apply automation.
  
  

This goes beyond using AI personally. It means deploying AI at the team level, changing how the work actually gets done, and being able to show the difference in throughput and quality. We are not looking for someone who is curious about AI. We are looking for someone who already thinks in systems and sees AI as the most powerful leverage point in a modern delivery organization.
  
  

What You Bring
  
  

This role sits at the intersection of enterprise client leadership and high\-volume operational delivery. Strength in only one of those will not be enough.
  
  

Experience and Background
  
  

7\+ years in implementation, onboarding, professional services, product, or delivery leadership, with at least 3 years managing people.
  
Direct experience owning enterprise implementation programs end to end, with executive\-level client stakeholders and hard external deadlines.
  
Demonstrated ownership of high\-volume operational delivery at scale, such as data migrations, platform migrations, or mass provisioning, where accuracy across thousands of records was the measure of success.
  
Experience in financial services, wealth management, insurance, or another regulated industry, with working knowledge of what compliance review means for delivery timelines.
  
Track record of building a function rather than inheriting one: writing the SOPs, defining the metrics, and standing up the operating rhythm.
  
Experience owning a process or system roadmap, not just running the process, including deciding what changes get built and in what order.
  
Experience managing external or outsourced delivery capacity, including scoping work to a vendor and holding it to a quality standard.
  
SaaS or platform delivery experience, with fluency in SSO, CRM integration, data provisioning, and API\-adjacent concepts sufficient to lead technical conversations credibly.
  
  

Skills and Qualifications
  
  

Executive presence. Can hold a room with a client's senior leadership, deliver bad news cleanly, and reset an expectation without damaging the relationship.
  
Willingness to push back internally and externally, and the judgment to know which fights are worth having.
  
Rigorous operational discipline. Comfortable in the detail of a migration checklist and in a portfolio\-level status review on the same day.
  
Product thinking. Can map a current\-state process, define the target state and roadmap the changes between them.
  
Strong systems thinking, with a bias toward building the repeatable process over solving the same problem twice.
  
Credible technical range. Does not need to configure the platform, does need to know when an answer does not add up.
  
Clear, concise written communication, particularly status reporting that a busy executive can act on.
  
Ability to run many concurrent programs with competing external deadlines without losing the thread on any of them.
  
Genuine people leadership. Sets a high bar, gives direct feedback, and develops managers into owners.

Employee will be assigned to the Office of the Chief, Environmental Management Service (EMS), VA Medical Center, Battle Creek, MI. U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

Duties include, but may not be limited to the following:

jobs.title: SENIOR BUSINESS IMPLEMENTATION CONSULTANT - NORTH AMERICA
jobs.description:
### **About Us**


Phenom Cloud is a partner in enterprise digital transformation. We lead with innovative cloud, business, ERP, and people\-centric solutions, crafting groundbreaking strategies from our global innovation hubs to meet your unique needs. Our blend of deep expertise and best practices empowers you to boost performance, drive continuous improvement, and secure lasting results.


### **Position Summary**


The Senior Business Implementation Consultant is responsible for delivering consulting/implementation services to customers and defining, improving, and driving best practices across the North America practice within the customer base. The Senior Business Implementation Consultant will also work in pre\-sales engagements, during the presentation and/or scoping phases.


### **Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Focus on business requirements gathering, functional solutions, and testing, including conducting business requirement analysis and gap analysis.
* Develop and recommend solutions and strategies for functional solutions based on the analysis of customer business goals, objectives, needs, and existing business workflow.
* Use industry expertise to spot gaps and pitfalls in business requirements and existing customer processes and steer customers toward an optimal solution.
* Identify and recommend solutions to meet client business requirements, guiding customers through functional options thoroughly.
* Facilitate and lead business process and configuration workshops.
* Work with the Phenom Cloud Project Manager to define the optimum project delivery strategy and plan.
* Provide functional and business leadership to the client as well as the cross\-functional delivery team.
* Lead testing and validation of business requirements and functional solutions.
* Work with internal groups to define, deliver, and assist with post\-implementation issues.
* Lead specific workstreams within larger implementation programmes.
* Facilitate and lead the delivery of administrator training.
* Provide consulting on the functionality of the Cornerstone OnDemand and Odoo applications and industry best practices.
* Dedicate internal\-facing effort (approximately 10% of the role) to ensure best practices, functioning as a subject\-matter expert in relevant areas.
* Oversee and guide Learning (and Talent, where required) implementation projects.
* Meet utilization requirements and other KPIs related to individual and practice performance.
### **Skills \& Requirements**


* 10 or more years of consulting experience in the HCM space, with more than 7 years of consulting experience in medium/large\-scale projects; alternatively, experience on the customer side owning an LMS/HCM product.
* Communication: clear and understandable; articulates complex topics well; presents professionally; strong writing skills.
* Problem Solving: analyzes problems logically to identify root causes; seeks input from a wide range of sources and asks insightful questions.
* Presentation: able to command customer confidence as a subject\-matter expert; drives the group to the best applicable solution by applying in\-depth product and industry best practices.
* Presentation: projects confidence to help customers make the right decisions, utilizing Cornerstone and industry best practices; able to lead a group discussion.
* Presentation: able to engage with prospective customers during the scope discovery phase and drive discussion towards controlling project scope and schedules.
* Team Collaboration: contributes to overall team success in delivery and pre\-sales scenarios; drives the team to complete tasks on schedule and to a high standard of quality.
* Team Collaboration: provides support and guidance to consultants and analysts.
* Customer Satisfaction: understands the fundamentals of customer satisfaction for the software business; establishes trusting relationships with customers.
* Customer Satisfaction: continuously improves and seeks positive feedback from customers and internal stakeholders.
* Initiative: manages tasks with minimal supervision; leads and completes projects with complex customer requirements.
* Initiative: proactively spots and prevents project issues; manages risks and issues resolution; able to lead projects with premier clients.
* Deep subject\-matter expertise in relevant practice areas (e.g., learning management, talent management).
* Strong interpersonal skills and a high level of organizational skill, with the ability to coordinate the work of others.
* Degree with a Business major and Technical minor preferred; proficiency with Microsoft Office and understanding of the basic Cornerstone technology platform.
* No direct reporting responsibilities in this role.
* Right to work in the United States.

**Highly Desirable**
--------------------


* Cornerstone OnDemand certification(s).
* Experience with Odoo functional configuration.
* Change management experience or certification.
* Additional language skills relevant to target markets.
### **Benefits**


* Competitive salary and compensation package, with performance\-related variable pay (bonus).
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer contributions.
* Life and disability insurance.
* Paid time off plus US public holidays.
* Flexible, remote\-first working with occasional client\-site attendance.
* Professional development budget and certification support (including Cornerstone and platform certifications).
* A culture of continuous innovation.
### **How to Apply**


If you are an experienced professional ready to take on the Senior Business Implementation Consultant \- North America role and drive meaningful transformation for global enterprises, we would love to hear from you.


Phenom Cloud is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation.

jobs.description:
**The Company**


**Cerbo · OptiMantra** is a healthcare technology company built for the practices actively changing how medicine is delivered. Our platforms serve functional, integrative, direct primary care, concierge, med spa, and behavioral health practitioners who need software that keeps pace with how they work \- not the other way around.

  

Each platform is a purpose\-built EHR and practice management solution. **Cerbo** is architected for clinical depth: deep configuration, protocol\-specific workflows, and the kind of flexibility that holistic and functional medicine practices require. **OptiMantra** is structured for scale: multi\-modality breadth, out\-of\-the\-box readiness, and the operational infrastructure that growing practices rely on.

  

Together, our two platforms form a leading presence in this rapidly expanding market. Our practitioners are redefining what a patient experience can look like. We exist to give them the technology foundation to do exactly that \- at whatever size and pace they choose to grow.

 **About the Role**



As a **Customer Onboarding \& Implementation Specialist**, you’ll be on the front lines of our customer experience. You’ll help new practices launch successfully on **OptiMantra**, guide users through powerful features, and solve real problems for real people doing meaningful work in healthcare. If you love helping others, enjoy learning technology, and want your work to directly support wellness practitioners and patients—you’ll thrive in this role.

 **What You’ll Do**


* Lead new customers through onboarding and setup to ensure a smooth, confident start on the OptiMantra platform
* Train customers on platform features, workflows, and best practices
* Provide friendly, effective technical support via phone, email, and video calls
* Troubleshoot issues, think critically, and deliver solutions that make customers feel supported and heard
* Create and improve customer\-facing knowledge base articles and training videos
* Partner with internal teams to improve processes, documentation, and the overall customer experience

  


**What We’re Looking For**

  

* You genuinely enjoy helping people learn and succeed
* You’re a strong problem\-solver who isn’t afraid to dig in and figure things out
* You bring a customer\-first mindset and enjoy improving processes
* You’re comfortable with technology, including scheduling tools, spreadsheets, and database\-driven systems
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in customer support, onboarding, healthcare operations, or technology (experience level flexible for the right candidate)
* Experience with EMR/EHR or practice management platforms is a plus
* Background in customer support, IT/help desk, or a clinical/medical office environment is helpful

  


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


* Competitive compensation based on experience
* Paid Time Off and company holidays
* Comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits
* Short\-term and long\-term disability Insurance
* 401k plan with matching company contribution
* Real ownership and impact in a fast\-growing health tech company

  


**Location****:** 100% Remote

  

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
